# Open Intelligent UI

> Let agents author interfaces as IUI markup. Renderers draw the stream with UI SDK behaviors, a DESIGN.md, and client-side state/tools.

Docs: https://open-intelligent-ui.pages.dev/docs/
Repo: https://github.com/wzc520pyfm/open-intelligent-ui
Playground: https://open-intelligent-ui.pages.dev/

## Two roles (do not mix)

| Role | Job | What to load |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Integrator agent** | Wire the product: install renderer, `buildSystemPrompt`, stream, `checkMarkup` / repair, `onAction` / tools | `skills/integrate/SKILL.md`, this file, [Getting started](https://open-intelligent-ui.pages.dev/docs/guide/start) |
| **Author model** | Write IUI in the chat reply | System message from `buildSystemPrompt(...)` only — not the integrator skill |

## Quick start for a product

```bash
npm create open-intelligent-ui@latest my-app
cd my-app && npm install && npm run dev
```

Or install by hand:

```bash
npm install @open-intelligent-ui/react @open-intelligent-ui/core @ui-sdk/react @ui-sdk/core
```

Minimal loop:

1. Server: `buildSystemPrompt({ design?, library?, tools?, instructions? })` → system message.
2. Model streams text → strip a wrapping Markdown code fence if present → `<IntelligentUI source streaming tools onAction onWarning />`.
3. When the stream ends: `checkMarkup(reply, { library, tools })`; if `!ok`, send `repairMessage(result)` back (max 2 rounds), then draw the final reply.
4. `onAction` for `send`: append as a user turn and call the model again.

## Packages

| Package | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `@open-intelligent-ui/core` | Parse, state, DESIGN.md, library helpers |
| `@open-intelligent-ui/core/prompt` | `buildSystemPrompt` (server only; large) |
| `@open-intelligent-ui/core/check` | `checkMarkup`, `repairMessage` |
| `@open-intelligent-ui/react` / `vue` / `svelte` / `solid` / `web` | Renderers |
| `open-intelligent-ui` | Unscoped re-export of core |
| `create-open-intelligent-ui` | Scaffold (`npm create open-intelligent-ui`) |

## Agent skills in this repo

| Skill | When |
| --- | --- |
| `skills/integrate/SKILL.md` | Add Open Intelligent UI to an app |
| `skills/intelligent-ui/SKILL.md` | Write or fix IUI markup / `.iui` demos |
| `skills/motion/SKILL.md` | Motion attributes and review |

Hand-written product docs: `skills/intelligent-ui/references/integration.md`.
Generated language/component refs: `skills/**/references/` (except `integration.md`) — run `pnpm generate:skills` after prompt edits.

## Correctness (production)

- Do not rely on the model alone. Use `checkMarkup` + `repairMessage` before or after first paint.
- Log `onWarning` from the renderer.
- Full guide: https://open-intelligent-ui.pages.dev/docs/guide/correctness

## Markup is not HTML

IUI looks like Markdown + tags. Tags are whitelisted; expressions run in a sandbox; no arbitrary JS. Spec: `docs/spec.md`. Safety: `docs/architecture.md` (安全模型).

## Optional deeper reading

- Extending (library, charts, motion): `docs/extending.md`
- Research vs A2UI / OpenUI: `docs/research.md`
- Architecture: `docs/architecture.md`
